Version 1.0.3

- Updated skill metadata: changed name from "phy-content-compound" to "Content Compound"
- Bumped version in metadata from 1.0.2 to 1.0.3
- No code or feature changes; documentation and metadata updates only

- Bumped version to 1.0.2 in metadata.
- Added an Author section at the end, including links to Canlah AI’s website, GitHub, and skill directory.
- No changes to tool features, usage, or technical details.

- Updated author name in metadata to "Canlah AI"
- Increased version to 1.0.1
- Added a homepage URL (https://canlah.ai) to metadata

- Initial release of phy-content-compound, an automated content atom library builder for social media creators.
- Scans markdown and text files to extract reusable "content atoms" (claims, data points, anecdotes, frameworks, contrarian takes, questions).
- Tags each atom with topic keywords and source attribution for easy retrieval.
- Supports querying by topic, atom type, result count, and output format (JSON).
- Outputs relevant atoms and generates post outlines to streamline content creation and fight creator burnout.
- No external dependencies; pure Python 3.7+ standard library.
